newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French bond futures climbed to the highest level since February 1994 as the euphoria that followed Tuesday's U.S. inflation data continued to buoy prices, flushing out some investors who had sold bonds previously, traders said.
Weakness in the U.S. bond market in the afternoon, however, weighed on prices, prompting a round of profit taking which traders had widely predicted earlier in the day.

While some traders said the mild "correction" could continue on Thursday, losses would be limited as bonds were still well supported and the overall trend remained favourable. They said a test of the historic high of 131.28 remained a possibility.
